g.ns0:title: Seqvium 09 — arranged fragments
g.ns0:desc: Hand-reconstructed vector interpretation of the owner's raster concept. Intentional opposing slopes, displaced overlaps, no tracing or embedded bitmap.

g.ns0:title: Seqvium 01 — layered sequence, retained alternative
g.ns0:desc: Editable reconstruction from the owner's concept; four displaced sequencer lanes and a stepped cyan phrase.

g.ns0:title: Seqvium 07 — structured flow, retained alternative
g.ns0:desc: Editable reconstruction of a continuous S ribbon, with a displaced rear lane. A development alternative, not the application icon.
